calls.thesis: Reiterated HOLD / wait (prior HOLD): SpaceX could be a good long-term investment and has rebounded back around its IPO price, but he'd rather wait — valuation plus final lockup expirations coming off early investors over at least another month; Nvidia holds ~123M shares (~$21B) and SpaceX is reportedly seeking ~$40B largely to buy Nvidia chips.

New: SpaceX rallied 54% from July low (+$750B market cap) on $254 Barclays initiation and low-band spectrum deal; valuation rich at ~80x earnings on $2/share next-yr profits; lockup overhang through early Dec keeps him sidelined.
calls.price_at_call: Post-IPO pop ~$225; holding off another month
